color.note: Provisional palette: wheat gold, earth brown and cream, because the logo file was not attached. Re-run with the official colors once received.

tokens.name: primary-50
tokens.usage: Faintest wheat tint: selected rows, subtle highlights.

tokens.name: primary-100
tokens.usage: Light wheat tint: chip and badge backgrounds.

tokens.name: primary-200
tokens.usage: Soft wheat tint: dividers on cream, decorative bands.

tokens.name: primary-300
tokens.usage: Gold text and focus ring on dark (brown) surfaces; pressed fill of the primary button.

tokens.name: primary-400
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the primary button; gold text on dark surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-500
tokens.usage: Brand wheat gold #C08A2E. Primary button fill, accents, icons on brown. Never body text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-600
tokens.usage: Decorative strokes and large icons on light surfaces (3:1 on paper).

tokens.name: primary-700
tokens.usage: Gold text on paper, cream and surface (overline, small labels): 4.8:1 or better. Use through accent-text.

tokens.name: primary-800
tokens.usage: Deep gold for large display accents on light surfaces.

tokens.name: primary-900
tokens.usage: Darkest gold: rare, borders on gold tints.

tokens.name: secondary-50
tokens.usage: Faintest earth tint.

tokens.name: secondary-100
tokens.usage: Light earth tint: hover on ghost buttons.

tokens.name: secondary-200
tokens.usage: Soft earth tint: disabled borders.

tokens.name: secondary-300
tokens.usage: Mid-light earth: decorative.

tokens.name: secondary-400
tokens.usage: Mid earth: large decorative marks, 3:1 on paper.

tokens.name: secondary-500
tokens.usage: Muted earth: icons and secondary strokes, 5:1 on paper.

tokens.name: secondary-600
tokens.usage: Dark earth: dark-theme dividers, hover of the call button.

tokens.name: secondary-700
tokens.usage: Brand earth brown #4A3B2A. Call button fill, brown surfaces, footer, secondary text on cream.

tokens.name: secondary-800
tokens.usage: Raised surface on brown (cards in the dark theme).

tokens.name: secondary-900
tokens.usage: Deepest brown: ink on light surfaces, page background of the dark theme.

tokens.name: cream
tokens.usage: Accent cream #F5EFE6. Alternate section bands, image placeholder surface, text on brown surfaces.

tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background. Dark theme: the brown page background.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, drawers sitting on paper.

tokens.name: surface-alt
tokens.usage: Alternate bands, image placeholder surface, table stripes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Body and heading text on paper, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, helper text, captions on paper, surface and surface-alt.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Decorative hairlines and card borders (not a control boundary).

tokens.name: border-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary button, chips): 3:1 or better on paper, surface and cream.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Link text on paper and surface, always underlined. Dark: gold on brown.

tokens.name: link-hover
tokens.usage: Link hover; thicker underline as well.

tokens.name: accent-text
tokens.usage: Gold-family text (overline, labels) on paper, surface, surface-alt. 4.8:1+ on light; 8:1+ on brown.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on primary-500 / 400 / 300 fills. Same in both themes.

tokens.name: call-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of the Call (phone) button.

tokens.name: on-call
tokens.usage: Text and icon on the Call button.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring, 3px solid with 2px offset. 3:1 or better on every surface it lands on.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Lightbox overlay behind the photo.

tokens.name: whatsapp
tokens.usage: WhatsApp utility green: the WhatsApp button and floating button fill only. Nowhere else.

tokens.name: whatsapp-hover
tokens.usage: Hover fill of the WhatsApp button.

tokens.name: whatsapp-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed fill of the WhatsApp button.

tokens.name: on-whatsapp
tokens.usage: Text and icon on WhatsApp green. White on this green fails AA, so use this dark green.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Success text and icon on success-bg. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: success-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for success alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning text and icon on warning-bg. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: warning-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for warning alerts and badges.

tokens.name: error
tokens.usage: Error text and icon on error-bg. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: error-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for error alerts and badges.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info text and icon on info-bg. Always paired with an icon and a word.

tokens.name: info-bg
tokens.usage: Background tint for info alerts and badges.

tokens.name: radius-lg

tokens.name: radius-pill

shadow.note: Two elevation levels: flat (border only) and raised (soft shadow).

tokens.name: shadow-flat
tokens.usage: Elevation 0: card with a 1px line border, no shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-raised
tokens.usage: Elevation 1: raised card, toast, drawer, floating WhatsApp. Soft and subtle only.

tokens.name: border-1
tokens.usage: Card and divider borders.

tokens.name: border-2
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, secondary button, chips).

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focus ring thickness.

layout.note: Container, gutters, breakpoints and minimum control sizes. Columns: 4 below 768, 8 from 768, 12 from 1024.

tokens.name: container-max
tokens.usage: Container max width.

tokens.name: gutter-m
tokens.usage: Container side padding below 768px.

tokens.name: gutter-d
tokens.usage: Container side padding from 768px.

tokens.name: bp-sm
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: large phone. 4 columns below 768.

tokens.name: bp-md
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: tablet, 8 columns.

tokens.name: bp-lg
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: small desktop, 12 columns.

tokens.name: bp-xl
tokens.usage: Breakpoint: desktop.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of buttons and form controls.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum tap target for icon buttons and links.
